default.description: Both Athena windows: window controls for her window, the global shortcut, and the one system notification when a draft's job ends while the app is away.

page.description: The tabs of her browser (ADR 0013): untrusted remote pages. Exactly one command, browser_reply, and nothing else. A page can only hand the relay an answer tagged with its tab's nonce; a wrong nonce or an id nobody waits on is dropped in Rust (src/browser.rs). The remote urls are wide because a tab may be pointed anywhere: the narrowing is the command list. Both the bare and the :* spellings are listed because a URL pattern built from http://* leaves the port empty, which means the scheme's default.
